title: sysc-metrics M2: power and thermal collectors
description: Unbuilt and undesigned upstream work that gates Tranche 3C. External repo /home/nomadx/sysc-metrics at d821afe: no Go file mentions battery, thermal, upower or power_supply, and its only plan is core counters. Its design specifies the contract: thermal-zone parsing, UPower DisplayDevice collection preferred, sysfs power-supply fallback, source-transition handling, multi-battery tests, and suspend/resume qualification on real hardware. Needs its own design and plan in that repo, then a release tag containing power before sysc-shell can consume it.

description: Deferred Milestone 2 hardware qualification.
